data.title: 和栗薰子 · 烘焙体验课的第一盘饼干
data.description: 周末烘焙体验课上，薰子穿奶油棕格纹衬衫和薄荷绿围裙，戴厚隔热手套将刚出炉的饼干盘放上木台。黑紫色长发束好，蓝眼认真比较几块不太规则的饼干，随后为自己的第一次成果露出灿烂笑容。这是体验课，并非自家蛋糕店。
data.action: 戴隔热手套放下饼干盘，检查初次成果后开心微笑。
data.promptProse: At the weekend baking lesson, Kaoruko Waguri sets a hot cookie tray onto the wooden worktable with padded mitts. Her cream-and-brown checked shirt and mint apron stay tidy as she studies the uneven first batch, then breaks into a bright blue-eyed smile. The medium view includes classroom workstations and the oven behind. Soft bright window light reveals cookie edges and mitt quilting, with the tray casting a solid shadow on the wood.
